description: A C# game engine in which a program opens a window, draws each frame with plain static calls named as raylib's functions are, and draws Dear ImGui in the same frame, over SDL3, Vulkan and Slang, with an ECS and source-generated behaviors underneath.
releaseNotes:
A program sets a plane its glossy surfaces mirror the scene in, drawn from the mirrored camera at half the window's size and read by the model pass and by a shader of the program's own.
Pinball's status says when the ball is in its lane, and the drive launches a ball back at its plunger again, three times at most, before it fails.
The sun can be given a width across, which softens its shadow's edge with the distance from what casts it, sharp at a pole's foot and soft at its tip.
title: 3DEngine
